text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I caught sight of two horse girls 
getting ready for a tandem training run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Ryan. ...I'm giving this 
everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Same to you! A full-power tandem 
run against each other... I'm getting 
pumped!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the two giving off a race-day level 
of tension, the surrounding horse girls 
began buzzing with excitement—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey look, it's the two from the Mejiro 
family...! Doesn't it feel... super 
serious?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Are they about to do a tandem run...? We 
gotta watch this up close...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... having everyone watch makes me a 
bit nervous. Don't you think so too, 
Dober—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah— S-Sorry. Did you say something just 
now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Whenever you can't shake off the 
nerves, you know, thinking about something 
you love can help you focus.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
For me, I think about muscle engagement 
and mechanics. ...Why don't you give it a 
try too, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks. I'll keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...Well then, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haah...! Haah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Failing to answer Ryan's full effort is 
not an option. I will stay focused all the 
way to the end...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Strawberry, apple, kiwi, mango, banana, 
grape, pineapple—!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Dober's pace suddenly picked up—?! I... 
can't lose to this!!)

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
KYAAA—! Ryan-san! Dober-san! Do your best, 
both of you—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Fruit parfait, parfait, parfait—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: PARFAIIIIIIITTTT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Did I... manage to run...? Properly... all 
the way to the end...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Dober! That was insanely awesome! 
Especially that late acceleration! That 
was incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Dober-san! Ryan-san! That run just now was 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mesmerized by their all-out tandem run, 
horse girls had gathered around them 
before they even realized it.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Dober-san's final acceleration...! It was 
so cool~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Kh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As high-pitched cheers rose from the 
onlookers, Mejiro Dober's running slowed 
down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haa... and things were going so well... 
Here I go again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Dober! Good work out there! That 
concentration was incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Dober-san! Ryan-san! That run just now 
from both of you was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mesmerized by their all-out tandem run, 
horse girls had gathered around them 
before they even realized it.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Dober-san looked so serious while 
running... It was wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...T-Thank... you. Well, I'll be going 
now—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Dober-san left. Even the way she 
leaves is so cool and charming~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(...Did she get embarrassed? Still, that 
was truly amazing, Dober!)
